subject: Evaluation bakeoff playbook — technical milestones & owners
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <ajohnson@careledger.com>, Priya Menon <priya.menon@careledger.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Evaluation bakeoff playbook — technical milestones & owners

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for a productive demo earlier. Per our call I put together a concise bakeoff playbook + MAP items so we have a single source of truth for responsibilities, success criteria and timing. I attached a working MAP (CareLedger_MAP_v2.xlsx) and a short Redwood bakeoff profile doc that shows our recommended benchmarking configurations.

High-level purpose: validate performance, cost, and functional parity on a representative subset of your inference traffic so you can make an informed procurement decision by mid-December.

Proposed technical success criteria (draft):
- Latency: P95 inference (single-turn, 2k token context) < 200 ms end-to-end from CareLedger staging to Redwood-hosted endpoint.
- Cost: unit cost <= $0.40 per 1k generated tokens under sustained throughput profile (as defined in attached testset).
- Stability: <1% error rate across 1k requests sampled from the testset; no severe out-of-memory or tokenization failures.
- Quality: automated reranking/metric parity >= baseline model (we'll use your labeled dev set for this).

Model shortlist (initial): Llama2-70B-Chat (quantized), Mistral-Instruct-70B, Falcon-40B-instruct (int8). Redwood will supply each model variant and quantization profile; CareLedger provides the evaluation testset (or grant us access to a sanitized copy).

Key dependencies we discussed:
- Test dataset access (anonymized) and expected throughput patterns — CareLedger
- Staging credentials and allowed egress IPs — CareLedger Infra
- SOC2 / security paperwork for private routing (if needed) — Redwood security team
- Agreement on short list (this message) and target decision date — mutual

Target timeline (draft):
- Data handoff: by 2026-11-17
- Infra access + whitelist: by 2026-11-19
- Bakeoff runs & analysis: 2026-11-20 through 2026-11-30
- Security/compliance review: by 2026-12-03
- Exec decision: week of 2026-12-13 (target close 2026-12-17)

Next steps for you: please confirm dataset availability and a point-of-contact for infra access. I’ll update the MAP spreadsheet with milestone owners once you confirm owners on your side.

Attaching: CareLedger_MAP_v2.xlsx, redwood-bakeoff-profiles.pdf, llm-bakeoff-testset-ids.txt

Thanks —
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

From: Alex Johnson <ajohnson@careledger.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Menon <priya.menon@careledger.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 17:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evaluation bakeoff playbook — technical milestones & owners

Thanks Mina — appreciate the clear write-up. Quick clarifications from our side: 

1) Dataset: we can provide an anonymized dev/test split of ~3k examples by 2026-11-16. The testset includes long-tail prompts that exercise context windows up to 4k tokens — will that change latency targets?

2) Infra: our infra owner is Michael Park (michael.park@careledger.com). He will need the IPs to whitelist; can you provide a short list of endpoints/egress IPs?

3) Security: Priya flagged that we need to see an up-to-date SOC2 report and a brief note on how Redwood handles KV cache retention and customer model artifacts. Can you point us to the attestation and a couple of bullet points we can share with procurement?

On shortlist: the models you listed look good. Two asks: include a distilled 13B variant (for cost baseline) and one robust instruction-tuned 70B (we prefer redundancy).

Happy to commit to the timeline if infra + dataset handoff align.

Thanks —
Alex
Solutions Lead, CareLedger
ajohnson@careledger.com | +1 617-555-2367

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evaluation bakeoff playbook — technical milestones & owners

Appreciate the quick replies, Alex — answers inline and an updated milestone/owner summary below. I also added the distilled 13B you requested and an extra 70B variant to the shortlist.

1) Dataset: 4k token contexts are fine — we’ll include a separate latency slice for >2k contexts and report both P95 numbers. Updated latency goal: P95 < 350 ms for 4k contexts; P95 < 200 ms for 2k contexts (both measured end-to-end).

2) Infra IPs: attaching a short firewall whitelist matrix in the Drive link (redwood-hosted egress endpoints). I’ll also share a temporary SSH jump for Michael if they prefer a host-based transfer.

3) Security: SOC2 report link included in related_links. Brief bullets you can pass to procurement:
- SOC2 Type II (2026) available on request
- KV cache retention: default retention is ephemeral per-session and can be disabled; we provide configurable TTLs and explicit purge APIs.
- Model artifacts: Redwood does not persist customer prompt/response pairs unless opt-in for quality monitoring; customers can opt-out and retain all artifacts on-prem.

Updated milestone table (owners & target dates):
- Data handoff: CareLedger — Alex Johnson — target 2026-11-16 (STATUS: authorizing dataset share)
- Infra access & whitelist: CareLedger Infra — Michael Park — target 2026-11-19 (Michael to confirm IP list)
- Bakeoff execution & initial analysis: Redwood SRE + Solutions — Rishi Malhotra / Mina Haddad — 2026-11-20 to 2026-11-30
- Security/compliance checklist + decision gating: Redwood Security + CareLedger Sec — Marissa Cole / Priya Menon — target 2026-12-03
- Exec readout & procurement signoff: CareLedger Execs — Priya Menon — target decision week of 2026-12-13 (close 2026-12-17)

Deliverables from Redwood during bakeoff:
- Repro script + runbook for each model variant
- Per-model latency/cost/quality report (CSV + dashboard snapshot)
- RK sampling of failure cases and tokenization quirks

If that mapping looks right, Alex — I’ll move these into the MAP spreadsheet and set calendar invites for the infra handoff and kickoff run. Also tagging Rishi and Marissa internally to confirm Redwood's internal owners.

Mina

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: bakeoff ownership notes

Rishi / Mina — quick internal note to confirm what we'll own for the bakeoff:

- Redwood will provide quantized model builds and the perf harness (I will own the deliverable).
- Rishi: please allocate 4 GPU-hours/day from our Dedicated pool for 11/20–11/30 and prioritize the 70B-quant and 13B-distilled runs the first two days.
- I will draft the short README for procurement on KV cache retention and model artifact handling (one-pager) and drop in the Drive link by EOD 11/12.

Mina — I copied you so the internal plan aligns with the customer milestones. Once Michael confirms whitelist IPs I’ll schedule the kickoff runbook walk-through.

-Marissa
